powers.name: Paint
powers.text: Magic action, one pot: paint an object worth no more than 25 GP and it becomes real in your hands (a ladder, a rope, a shield, a lantern, a tent, a longsword...). The case holds 1d4 pots.

summary: 1d4 pots of paint: each paints a real, solid object worth up to 25 GP (a ladder, a rope, a shield, a lantern).
text: Whatever you paint flat with these pigments becomes a real, solid thing: focus on the image and the paint streams off the brush to shape it. They usually come as 1d4 pots in a fine wooden case with a brush. One pot covers 1,000 square feet of surface, enough to make inanimate objects or terrain features whose combined volume is no more than 10,000 cubic feet. Nothing made this way can be worth more than 25 GP. (In our game, each pot paints one object worth up to 25 GP into your hands: a ladder, a rope, a shield, a lantern and the like.)
